title: Why I'm betting on Rex
description:
*Rex:* https://www.superlogical.com/

Everyone's comparing Rex to herdr, Orca, and tmux, and writing it off for what it's missing. I think that's the wrong comparison. Rex is a terminal multiplexer first, and it's building the primitive everything else sits on.

I almost didn't try it. I had all my workflows built around herdr, and I wanted stability, not another tool to switch to. But after digging in, I think Rex is the one to bet on. In this video I explain what a multiplexer actually is, why every agent tool needs one, how Rex's mirroring differs from tmux, and why I'm building my workflows around it.
